entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God of the Hunt, Seasons, and Wilds on Theros.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane where Nylea is a god.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: God of the Harvests who has a tumultuous relationship with Nylea.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: Satyr who seized godhood through the Great Revel and imprisoned Nylea.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who slew Xenagos and was killed by Heliod.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who freed Nylea with Elspeth.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: God who killed Elspeth with Godsend.

entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: Nylea's favored hydra, slain by Elspeth.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: Nylea's beloved oracle, killed by Elspeth.

entities.name: Silence of the Gods
entities.description: Period when Theros's gods fell quiet.

entities.name: Great Revel
entities.description: Event through which Xenagos seized godhood.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: Realm of the gods where the deicide took place.

events.summary: During the Silence of the Gods, Xenagos ascends through the Great Revel and imprisons Nylea in beast form.
events.quote: imprisoning Nylea in the form of a beast within her domain

events.summary: Elspeth and Ajani free Nylea in Nyx, and Elspeth slays Xenagos with an arrow Nylea struck.
events.quote: The pair freed her from her magical prison, restoring her true form

events.summary: Nylea forgives Elspeth, but Heliod kills Elspeth with Godsend.
events.quote: Heliod killed Elspeth with her weapon, Godsend

events.summary: After Xenagos's fall Nylea's authority over Theros's wild places is restored.
events.quote: Nylea’s authority over the wild places of Theros was restored.
